Location : Remote (Australia, Canada, Ireland, UK, New Zealand, United States)
Applicants must currently reside in Australia, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, New Zealand or the United States.
We are recruiting English-speaking contributors from all backgrounds for content-review support on AI projects. You will apply tags, check evidence and organize completed reviews.
- Review assigned content items with the provided decision guide.
- Apply standard tags to content that meets clear criteria.
- Check records for the evidence required by each tag.
- Capture questions about uncertain content examples.
- Organize completed content reviews for quality follow-up.
- Must be at least 18 years old and able to communicate in English.
- Ability to recognize information requested in an English content guide.
- Ability to use standard tags and retain supporting details.
- Reliable high-speed internet and a suitable home-working setup.
- Previous experience in supporting content review is helpful but not required.
We welcome applications from qualified individuals of all backgrounds. Applicants are considered based on relevant skills, qualifications and project eligibility requirements, without discrimination on grounds protected by applicable law.
